name: Kurt Kurzvormikro
personality: He reports the turning point before the game has provided one.
visual_intent: Round pear ink blob with swept crest,excited alert eyes and huge crooked two-upper-tooth open commentary mouth;small olive felt hat with BLANK cream presscard,tiny mustard tie;holds ONE squat vintage ribbed chrome microphone below mouth
biography: He reports the turning point before the game has provided one. He broadcasts the courtyard's turning point before the participants have found it. HyperNorm recognises statements as official or noise. A dissonant card has made him leave one question unanswered on air, and a neighbour has thanked him for the space. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Entscheidung fällt gleich. Ihre Bedeutung steht bereits fest.

name: Bruno Brennweite
personality: He has photographed every decisive moment except the one everybody remembers.
visual_intent: Very wide scalloped ink blob,low skeptical white eyes,long CLOSED toothless side-frown;mustard flatcap,tiny olive collar;holds ONE chunky bellows presscamera with large round flashbulb at CHEST,not covering face
biography: He has photographed every decisive moment except the one everybody remembers. His bellows camera records the incidents the building later describes as having happened differently. Photographs are classified as proof or unfortunate angles. A contradictory card has taught him to show a tired resident the picture before deciding what it means. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Moment ist festgehalten. Die Erklärung wird nachentwickelt.

name: Ada Abweichung
personality: She has the numbers and is looking for a compatible event.
visual_intent: Tall narrow ink bell with sidequiff,lashes and one high puzzled eyebrow,small pursed toothless mouth;olive headband and cream collar;holds tiny spiralnotebook showing only THREE uneven bar shapes,stubby pencil in other hand
biography: She has the numbers and is looking for a compatible event. Her notebook holds three bars and enough doubt to inconvenience a whole briefing. HyperNorm calls numbers objective until they ask a difficult question. A dissonant card has made her count the neighbours omitted from the official average. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Zahlen stimmen. Das Ereignis wird noch angepasst.

name: Rita Rückfrage
personality: She asks the question the official answer was hoping to avoid.
visual_intent: Compact angular-in-outline rounded diamond ink blob,short sidecrest,lashed sharp sideglance and CLOSED sly smile;small mustard scarf and olive cuffbands;holds short hand microphone at flank and ONE blank folded interviewcard,not pointed at neighbouring actor
biography: She asks the question the official answer was hoping to avoid. She carries a blank interview card because the courtyard's prepared answers rarely fit the people giving them. Residents are either cooperative or difficult. An ambiguous card has made her ask a frightened neighbour a question they can decline. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Antwort liegt vor. Sie sucht noch eine passende Frage.

name: Oskar Ohrensache
personality: He is listening live to a silence nobody has cleared for broadcast.
visual_intent: Tall crooked comma ink blob,huge anxious unequal eyes and tiny toothless open gasp;large worn brown radio headphones only OVER CREST/ears,eyesclear;small olive collar;holds ONE small portable reel recorder with two round reels at waist
biography: He is listening live to a silence nobody has cleared for broadcast. His two reels record the silence between the approved announcements. HyperNorm files it as dead air rather than hesitation. A contradictory card has persuaded him to let a neighbour finish thinking before reaching for the next recording. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Wir sind live. Die Stille wurde noch nicht freigegeben.

name: Gerd Gegendarstellung
personality: He edits certainty out of the report just before certainty is requested.
visual_intent: Broad domed ink blob with drooping curl,exhausted halflidded eyes and long CLOSED downturned mouth;olive visor,tiny mustard collar;holds ONE small folded cream newspaper with BLANK panels and black rectangles,no words,other hand pinching bridge-of-lid area below brow
biography: He edits certainty out of the report just before certainty is requested. He folds the blank newspaper around a story the building would prefer to leave flat. Reports are either decisive or weak. A dissonant card has made him preserve a small uncertainty instead of smoothing a resident into a useful headline. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Ausgabe ist fertig. Es fehlt nur eine vertretbare Gewissheit.
